## Project Overview

The fixture project is a nearly empty git repository with a TypeScript-first toolchain. The requested feature is a static user profile helper with a colocated test, so the work stays inside one small module boundary.

## Architecture

There is no application framework, router, or data layer. A plain exported helper module keeps the feature isolated and avoids introducing runtime dependencies the fixture does not have.

## Relevant Code

No existing source module relates to the feature; the repository carries only fixture bookkeeping files, so the helper starts from a clean slate.

## Patterns to Follow

Exported functions with explicit return types, colocated Vitest describe blocks, and no hidden state or I/O.

## Dependencies & Constraints

No new packages: the helper must be plain TypeScript with no imports beyond the test runner. The fixture stays a single-module feature.

## Implementation Considerations

The profile data is static, so the helper returns deterministic literal values and performs no fetching, caching, or persistence.

## Validation Tools

This run configures no test, typecheck, or lint stage; correctness is judged by the task brief checks and the final review.

data: {"choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"content":"# Specification

## Overview

Provide a static user profile helper for the fixture project so callers can read the fixture user identity without any data source.

## User Scenarios

- A developer imports the profile helper and receives the fixture user profile object.
- A test asserts the returned identity fields to document the expected shape.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The helper returns the fixture profile with its identifier, display name, and role.
- A colocated test file exercises the helper and asserts the full profile object.

## Functional Requirements

- The module exports a single profile function returning a typed profile object.
- The returned profile is static and deterministic across calls.

## Non-Functional Requirements

- No I/O, no network access, and no mutable module state.

## Out of Scope

- Any profile editing, persistence, or API transport. The feature is read-only and local.

Add a static user profile helper and a colocated Vitest test for the fixture project.

## Architecture Decisions
- Keep the profile data inline: the fixture project has no data layer to read from.
- Colocate the test with the helper so the feature stays in one module boundary.

## File Structure
### New Files
- `src/profile.ts`
  Purpose: export a getUserProfile helper that returns the fixture user profile.
- `src/profile.test.ts`
  Purpose: assert the helper returns the fixture id, name, and role.

### Modified Files

## Dependencies
None. The fixture project already depends on Vitest.

## Data Model
UserProfile: { id: string; name: string; role: string }.

## Key Implementation Details
- getUserProfile(): UserProfile returns the fixture user with no I/O and no persistence.

## Testing Strategy
- One Vitest case asserting the returned name and role."},"finish_reason":null}]}
